name: Top Gun National Walker

about.title: About Our Team
about.description: Top Gun National Walker (formerly Stars National Walker) is an elite 16U travel softball team based in Charlotte, NC with players from around the country. We compete in top-tier national tournaments and are dedicated to player development and college placement.

features.title: Elite Competition
features.description: We compete in PGF, Alliance, and other top-tier national tournaments.

features.title: College Placement
features.description: Dedicated recruiting support to help players find their perfect college fit.

features.title: Player Development
features.description: Focused on developing well-rounded athletes both on and off the field.

coaches.name: Joe Walker
coaches.title: Head Coach
coaches.bio: Coach Joe Walker founded the program now known as Top Gun National Walker with a vision of developing elite softball players who excel both on the field and in the classroom. An expert in lock-down defense and game strategy, he works directly with infielders to build fundamentally sound players. His deep understanding of the recruiting landscape prepares athletes for success at the next level.

coaches.name: Adrian Diaz
coaches.title: Administrative Coach
coaches.bio: Coach Adrian Diaz is the administrative coach for Top Gun National Walker, after previously leading the team’s outfield development. His player-first mentality and clear communication keep the program organized so players can focus on the field.

coaches.name: Jeremiah Perez
coaches.title: Assistant Coach
coaches.bio: Coach Jeremiah focuses on hitting and infield development, with a keen eye for mechanical adjustments that unlock power and consistency at the plate. His positive coaching style and attention to detail help players build confidence and reach their full potential.

coaches.name: Michael Orlando
coaches.title: Outfield Coach
coaches.bio: Coach Michael Orlando played college baseball at UMBC, where he was the Retrievers’ leadoff hitter and an outfielder who split time between center and right field. As a sophomore in 2003 he was named The Retriever Weekly’s Athlete of the Week after going 6-for-12 in a conference series against Wagner, and he led the team in runs scored while going a perfect 4-for-4 on stolen bases. A Rochester, New York native, he now leads outfield development for Top Gun National Walker, where his daughter, Cara Orlando (Class of 2028), plays outfield.

recruitingCoordinator.name: Mike Usry
recruitingCoordinator.title: Recruiting Coordinator
recruitingCoordinator.bio:
Mike played Division I football at Georgia and South Florida, so he knows the recruiting process from the inside — what college coaches are actually evaluating, and what it takes to earn a spot at the next level. As Top Gun National Walker's recruiting coordinator, that's the work he owns: building each player's target school list, getting her video and profile in front of the right coaches, and managing the outreach and follow-up that turns interest into offers.

Mike treats recruiting as the team's responsibility, not something families have to figure out alone. He has helped athletes across multiple sports secure Division I scholarships, and brings that same hands-on advocacy to every player on the roster — finding the right athletic, academic, and cultural fit for each one.
